title: app
description: Windows desktop application configuration for automation using NovaWindows Driver.

anyOf.description: Name of the application. Use a common app name (e.g., 'notepad', 'calculator', 'paint') or provide a path in the full config.

name.description: Application identifier. Can be a common app name (resolved automatically) or a descriptive name when using a custom path.

path.description: Full path to the .exe file or UWP package ID. If not specified, Doc Detective will attempt to resolve the path from the name.

launchTimeout.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the application to launch.

windowTitle.description: Expected window title to match when finding the application window.

keepAppOpen.description: If true, the application is left open after the test completes. If false, the application is closed.

clickDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds after each click action.

smoothMouseMove.description: If true, mouse movements are smooth and animated. If false, mouse movements are instant.
